name: Cambridge Challenge 2022

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors.

information: The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition. Don't be late! This competition is on the first day of Daylight Savings Time, so make sure you turn your clocks forward so you don't miss the first hour.
